_readme: Disc ellipse per hand, measured on the shipped 1400x1750 layers. All values are percentages of the layer box: cx/rx of its WIDTH, cy of its HEIGHT. rx and ry are both given relative to WIDTH so a square disc stays square. To line every hand's disc up at one spot, see align_hint.
align_hint: Give the layer box width Wb and height Hb=Wb*1.25. The disc centre lands at (cx_pct*Wb, cy_pct*Hb) and its radius is rx_pct*Wb. To put every disc at target centre (Tx,Ty) with target radius Tr: scale = Tr/(rx_pct/100*Wb), then translate by (Tx - cx_pct/100*Wb*scale, Ty - cy_pct/100*Hb*scale).
